falsifier_requirement.trigger: model vector RMSE exceeds the declared uncertainty, comparator is not worse, target vector appears in visible inputs, or fewer than 20 locked official epochs are scored

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Two-body Kepler/Newton propagation from the previous heliocentric state vector using the predeclared solar GM constant and fixed integration step.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Propagate the previous vector by linear X,Y,Z += VX,VY,VZ*delta_t and keep velocity unchanged.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model vector RMSE must be lower than comparator vector RMSE on the same hidden epochs

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

required_source_block.source_authority: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory Solar System Dynamics
required_source_block.source_name: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics HORIZONS API vector ephemerides

residual_requirement.formula: sqrt(mean((predicted_component - observed_component)^2)) over X,Y,Z,VX,VY,VZ after unit normalization
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_residual < comparator_residual and residual_within_declared_uncertainty is true

target_variable.extraction_rule: For each epoch after the first, hide the official HORIZONS vector row until the predeclared dynamical propagation is materialized from prior visible rows.
target_variable.name: next_epoch_heliocentric_cartesian_state_vector

uncertainty_requirement.metric: componentwise absolute error with vector RMSE aggregation
uncertainty_requirement.rule: Use HORIZONS output precision from the locked snapshot plus a preregistered numerical integration tolerance; do not tune tolerance after target opening.

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
